                                                                            ---[ {3} Vis Comica ]---

   fullscreen = 1; lights = 0; drug = rand(4); music = INF;
   joy = band(fullscreen,music)*(drug+1)+bnot(lights);

   Not much music response showing up here so it's not perfect but        the *huge* diversity is the cool part about this one [apart from trippy-
   ness]

->Hit CTRL to lock pattern and SHIFT to change it manually; good for    using this preset as a random color-combo-picker :-D
->Enable the Invert and the 2nd last EL, it'll cut your fps in half but it's    definitely worth a try!
->The slider is the time until the pattern is changed on beat.
